mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% over a 6-month window signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2% for 6 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of GDPC1 below 2% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger in more than 60% of slowdown episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals improved manufacturing output, which historically drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO > 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger in more than 60% of expansion episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise and corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger in more than 60% of tightening episodes.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of HOUST < 800,000 units are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to trigger in more than 60% of downturn episodes.
